text:
Ana (partnerships): FYI — Snowpark + Databricks unity demo runs are scheduled next week. Need to lock embargo/press window and final perf numbers.
Mike G (eng): timeline? we have two staging slots (Tue/Wed). prefer Tue for long soak.
Sasha (PM): Tue works for GTM, but legal needs 72h pre-announce review. can we aim for Tue demo, Fri embargo lift?
Tom (field-eng): technical checklist for demo env: ingest sample (10k docs), vectorization job, query latency dashboard. I'll post the commands.
Ana (partnerships): @Sasha can you confirm if partner PR wants co-signed quote? also need logo assets and marketplace tile copy.
Sasha (PM): yes, partner wants co-signed quote + 2 co-demo slides. Legal asked for draft by Mon EOD.
Tom (field-eng): demo setup snippet: ```bash
./deploy_demo.sh --env=staging --partner snowpark --vector-db qdrant --sample-size 10000
kubectl port-forward svc/demo-dashboard 8080:80 -n demo
```
Mike G (eng): quick perf note: on a 4xA100 staging node with our batcher=auto we saw p50 ~210ms for 2k token queries; we should capture p95 too.
Ana (partnerships): partner PM (via Partner Bot): "We can provide a customer success engineer for run-throughs on Mon afternoon." :white_check_mark:
Sasha (PM): action items: 1) Tom to run soak Tue morning and publish perf CSV; 2) Mike to generate p50/p95 table and short blurb; 3) Ana to collect logos + press copy; 4) Legal to review draft by Mon EOD.
Tom (field-eng): will run soak Tue 06:00 UTC, will upload results to the demo folder and ping here.
Mike G (eng): I'll produce perf table and an ops note on failure modes (KV cache warmup, batch sizing).
Ana (partnerships): embargo window proposal: demo Tue, private partner preview Wed, embargo lift Fri 16:00 PT. Thoughts?
Sasha (PM): that should fit legal timing if draft delivered Mon. partner ok with Fri?
Partner Bot: Partner replied: "Fri 16:00 PT is fine. We'll send logo + quote by Mon 10:00 PT."
Ana (partnerships): perfect. last thing: marketplace listing readiness — does the tile need vector DB compatibility badge?
Tom (field-eng): yes, we should include badges: "Snowpark-ready", "Databricks validated", "Qdrant-compatible". I'll attach the compatibility test checklist after the soak.
Mike G (eng): small risk: large embeddings job spikes CPU during bulk ingest — we should cap ingest concurrency in demo script: `--concurrency 8`.
Sasha (PM): noted. I'll add that to the runbook. who owns the runbook link?
Tom (field-eng): I will create the runbook in the staging repo and add access to partner CSEs. link will be posted once soak completes.
Ana (partnerships): thanks all — final sync Mon 9:30 PT to confirm legal + assets. I'll schedule calendar invite. :calendar:
Mike G (eng): thumbs up.
Sasha (PM): thanks — will draft the PR language and share in the doc.
Partner Bot: Reminder set: demo run Tue 06:00 UTC.
